comparison.objective: Candidate removes one terminal; record counts and transfers eleven nuts using a mechanical tally counter.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate performs fine recessed release and coordinated pulling; record resets and actuates a counter while repeatedly transferring small loose parts without dropping them.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective intact extraction; record requires all nuts in the tray, a matching 0011 reading, prior zeroing, release, and rest.
comparison.reason: The record tests counting-state synchronization and repeated transfer, not latch manipulation.
